SEO_TITLE: Prompt Versioning Lite — git for prompts, without the git
SEO_DESCRIPTION: Paste a prompt, get a shareable versioned URL. Every edit is a new revision with a side-by-side diff. One-click rerun on any model via LiteLLM.
SEO_KEYWORDS: prompt versioning, prompt diff, llm prompt manager, prompt history, litellm prompt versioning, prompt engineering tool
HERO_HEADLINE: Git for prompts, without the git.
HERO_SUBHEAD: Paste a prompt, get a shareable versioned URL. Every edit is a new revision with a side-by-side diff. Free for 10 prompts.
HERO_MICRO_PROOF: No sign-up for the free tier. Works with GPT, Claude, and Gemini via LiteLLM.
PROBLEM_STATEMENT: You tweak a prompt, it stops working, and you can't remember what the last good version said. Google Docs isn't for engineers, git is overkill for text, and Langfuse costs more than your side project earns. Prompt Versioning Lite is a URL you paste into Slack.
FEATURE_1_BODY: Every edit is a content-addressed revision (SHA-256). The URL is the receipt — nobody can rewrite history.
FEATURE_2_BODY: Word-level diff between any two revisions. See exactly what you changed when the model output shifted.
FEATURE_3_BODY: Pick a model, hit run — LiteLLM handles OpenAI / Anthropic / Google / Groq. Bring your own key on the free tier.
PRICING_FREE_BULLETS:
• 10 prompts, unlimited revisions each
  • 7-day history
  • Bring your own API keys
  • Public share URLs
PRICING_PRO_BULLETS:
• Unlimited prompts + revisions
  • Forever history
  • Private prompts (URL is un-guessable)
  • Team folders (email-invite)
  • Weekly diff digest email
FAQ_1_A: Free-tier prompts are public (that's how sharing works). Pro-tier prompts live at an un-guessable URL and are excluded from robots.txt. If you need SOC 2, we're not there yet — email hi@ and we'll tell you honestly.
FAQ_2_Q: Which models can I rerun against?
FAQ_2_A: Anything LiteLLM speaks — GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5, Llama via Groq, Mistral, Cohere. Bring your own API key. We proxy but do not store the key.
FAQ_3_Q: How is this different from Langfuse / Braintrust / Promptlayer?
FAQ_3_A: Those are eval + observability platforms. This is a URL you paste into Slack. If you already run evals, keep doing that — this is for the 10× more common case of 'wait, what did I change?'
FAQ_4_A: Yes, on Pro. `POST /api/v1/prompts` with a bearer token; the response is the URL. Fully documented at /docs/api once you're on Pro.
